name: Prophia
positioning: Lease abstraction for commercial portfolios, machine extraction checked by people before the data is used.
description: Prophia turns commercial lease documents into structured data. A document is uploaded, the platform extracts the terms, specialists audit the extraction, and the customer reviews before the abstract is finalised; each field stays linked back to the passage it came from. On top of that data it offers rent roll automation, a stacking plan that updates itself, encumbrance tracking, portfolio analytics and an AI assistant, and it exposes an MCP integration so the lease data can be queried from outside the product. It is sold in two tiers, Essentials and Portfolio, plus a stand-alone abstraction service.
real_estate_use: The situation is an acquisition or a portfolio handover where several hundred leases arrive as PDFs and the rent roll has to be trusted before an offer is made. Doing that by hand takes weeks and still leaves errors, which is Prophia's argument: it puts a human audit between the model and the answer, and links every abstracted term to the source text so an analyst can check a number instead of believing it. Once the deal closes the same data serves asset and leasing teams: the stacking plan reflects the current rent roll, critical dates are visible, and the encumbrances that constrain a future lease are on record rather than buried in a document nobody reopens.
features: AI lease abstraction with expert audit before delivery
Every abstracted field linked back to its source passage
MCP integration for querying lease data externally

use_cases.job: Verify a rent roll against the leases before closing an acquisition
Keep an asset management team working from current, sourced lease terms
